scope: Real MCP stdio and shared headless host authoring on Linux and Windows
checks: MCP mutation is observed through a separate direct CLI connection to the same host.
Durable retry receipt is replayed across MCP and direct CLI transports.
Stale revision errors retain native codes.
MCP EOF detaches without shutting down the host; authoritative revision remains persisted.
Existing standalone authoring, undo/redo, framing, notification and writer-exclusion cases run on both platforms.
